game_concept: A tower defense set in Snowy Hold – Chimney Roofs, snowy chimney rooftops: the sled courier must handle blizzard sprites while practicing functions. Core idea – Scope Sanctuary: Distinguish local from global variables to keep flint stones safe from blizzard sprites.
theme: Snowy Hold – Chimney Roofs: snowy chimney rooftops
core_gameplay_loop: In Chimney Roofs, repeat each round: Distinguish local from global variables to keep flint stones safe from blizzard sprites. Each round, blizzard sprites strike the larder door, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the scope_safe value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the larder door from blizzard sprites in Chimney Roofs: keep the scope_safe meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 31-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: scope_safe drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 31-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 4 (applied tier): Scope Sanctuary
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how scope_safe changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against blizzard sprites in Chimney Roofs.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 31 seconds while scope_safe > 0.
